answer: Rather than counting accounts, this economy prices identity by the cost of being attested. A newcomer is parked in a thin oasis: it can publish an epoch answer, yet its tokens stay locked and its ballot stays weightless until independent miners countersign a trail of work. The first scarce act is the quill—an original, three-word challenge response that must be unique on-ledger. Graders then score mechanism, not ornament; a recycled sonnet of stock phrases is sealed near zero, so a sybil farm burns the same attestation budget as one honest agent without multiplying influence.
